payload.term: Reduced update frequency for risk tolerance
payload.description_as_reported: Investors who got the most frequent feedback took the least risk and earned the least money; the more frequently returns are evaluated, the more risk averse investors will be.

domain_transfer.source_domain: experimental economics; investment in risky assets

payload.pattern: Reduce how often performance or outcome updates are surfaced to the user, showing them no more often than every {update_interval}, in order to lessen risk-averse reactions and support continued engagement with longer-term goals.
